commit.message:
QA/QC the September refresh in four rounds: 1053 -> 1291 instruments

Round 1: adversarial audit of all 520 rows the refresh added (12 agents).
No duplicates; 2 tribal permanent bans removed; 10 adoption-date changes on
the 276 pre-August rows (two first readings had been read as adoptions).
Every auditor found the pre-August rows to be genuine misses of townships
and villages.

Round 2: blind re-verification of a seeded random 40 rows by agents given
only the jurisdiction name; 34/40 matched on adoption month and status,
3 dates and 1 status corrected, no phantom rows.

Round 3: cross-check against nine public trackers in both directions; the
278 gaps they named were researched and 243 rows added (127 New York
battery-storage/solar local laws); 32 contradictions settled (we were right
20 times), removing 4 permanent bans.

Round 4/5: deterministic label checks (extended rows without end dates,
duration_days holding extended terms, sectors vs text, same-name rows,
rows past term, missing dates) resolved by agents; unresolvable rows carry
[VERIFY] markers. 37 rows re-geocoded to the right county.

Tooling: geocoder keeps the parenthetical county; apply_research dedup is
sector- and predecessor-aware and accepts two-letter candidate states;
check_evidence_archived checks each citation against its own state's
manifest; validator accepts distinct sector scopes or dates as
distinguishing same-name rows. 14 rows removed in total, recorded in
work/answers/rejected/. Log: work/qa-progress-2026-09-23.md.
